record.question: To burn one's finger.
options: to suffer from meddling in something
to get a burn injury on the hands
to get injured in an accident
record.explanation: Answer A: to suffer from meddling in something. “Burn one’s fingers” means suffer adverse consequences from an involvement or risky action; A is the closest printed choice. Independent check: “Burn one’s fingers” means suffer from involvement in something that goes wrong. Reference: https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/get-have-fingers-burned; https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/burn-your-fingers. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Exact printed question, choices and required directions/emphasis reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
